name: fuzz-fleet-reminder-blocks-end-turn
description: Fuzz pbd385 / pbd386 and playtest 8 pbd469 (Mentak: 4 ships at fleet pool 3 after producing a destroyer; 'Dismiss These Buttons' closed the reminder with nothing removed and End Turn went through). Fix (bot fuzz-triage-2): while ButtonHelper.fleetReport says the system is over its limits, the reminder's Dismiss is refused (units.remove validate + the deleteButtons handler; value.blocked carries the reason for the web) and turn.action End Turn / Pass are refused, judged on the board whether or not a reminder is open (value.overLimits); removing the excess lets the turn end. Base: pinned pbd385 saves 141 (+142: Xxcha's End Turn prompt; cv, 2 ca, fs at 313 with fleet pool 3); one more destroyer added there posts the reminder. A legacy End Turn click (the button itself, not an engine answer) is refused the same way (ScFollowGate.refuse hook: turnEnd, endOfTurnAbilities, passForRound, passingAbilities, concludeAndEndTurn).
